answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in echo, expire in tundra, and knoll lists each expiry. An adversary running 172 aliases thus needs 80 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1655 identities would post 689 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
